hooks.command: IFS= read -r -d '' j; case "$j" in *"git commit"*) printf %s "$j" | bun {src}/packages/ai-os/src/relay/hook.ts;; esac

IFS= read -r -d '' j; c=${j#*\"command\":\"}; c=${c%%\",\"*}; c=" ; ${c//[;&|(]/ ; } "; c=${c//  / }; c=${c//  / }; r=; case "$c" in *"; cat "*|*"; grep "*|*"; sed "*|*"; ls "*|*"; find "*|*"; du "*|*"; curl "*|*"; cd "*) r="coreutils: use rg, fd, sd, dua, xh, jaq or Read/Grep/Glob/Edit, absolute paths, no cd";; esac; case "$c" in *"; git commit "*) case "$c" in *" -- "*) ;; *) r="plain git commit takes the whole shared index: git commit -m <msg> -- <files>, ay code commit, or a private index";; esac;; esac; case "$c" in *"; git add -A"*|*"; git add . "*|*"; git add --all"*|*"; git stash"*) r="shared tree: stage explicit files, never stash";; esac; [ -n "$r" ] && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}' "$r"; exit 0
